subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt the open cross-repo Feishu candidate or start a fresh target-repo fix for this reply @mention bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the same-repository candidate is closed and the fork copy is not a proven, mergeable target-repo fix; maintainer intent is needed before creating another repair lane.

options.title: Repair or replace in target repo
options.body: Use the existing candidate as source context, but land a current-main OpenClaw fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

options.title: Wait on fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork author to rebase and address the prior mention-gating and routing concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as an open known Feishu bug until channel ownership bandwidth is available.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace in target repo
recommendation.body: Use the existing candidate as source context, but land a current-main OpenClaw fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention-handling work makes this the closest routing candidate for deciding the safe dropped-mention shape.
